name: CoherenceSoftRefit v2 (staged development with interim checks)
registered: 2026-10-24, before any v2 metric was computed
baseline: CoherenceSoftRefit v1 (lambda_min=1, lambda_max=8) from coherence_soft_20261023; SoftGroupRefit and PrunedFullCalRefit reported alongside.
development_data: 50 scenes, all already seen: 20 soft_refit_20261023 scenes (four-layer and complex, Moderate/Strong, Q -30..+30%) and the 30 coherence_soft_20261023 V1-V3 scenes. Support, Q, wavelet, sigma and observations fixed per scene; only the gain changes.
metrics: overall relative error; weak-event amplitude error (four-layer family); fault and pinch-out region errors (V2, V3); low-energy error (V3); background leakage; count of scenes with overall error > 1.
stage_gate: A stage is kept only if, versus the current best rule on all 50 scenes: mean overall-error ratio <= 0.99, mean weak-error ratio <= 1.02, mean fault and pinch-out ratios <= 1.02. Otherwise it is dropped and the registered fallback for that stage is tried once; if that also fails, the stage is abandoned and the current best rule is carried forward unchanged.

A.primary: Extend lambda_max to {8, 12, 16, 32} with lambda_min in {0.5, 1}; plus hybrid deletion: gain = 0 for non-fallback groups with c < tau, tau in {0.1, 0.2}.
A.fallback: If no candidate passes, keep v1 lambdas.

B.diagnosis: Regenerate the V3 coherent interference and multiple components (same seeds) and split the v1 error into interference, ground-roll, multiple-dominated and other samples (truth-side, diagnosis only).
B.primary: If interference dominates: discount c for groups whose best-match lag is consistent with one global straight line across >= 60% of the gather (slant-stack peak on the unshrunk gather).
B.fallback: If multiples dominate or the primary fails: discount c for groups lying at a fixed period (0.18 s / 0.36 s searched from the data autocorrelation) below a stronger group on the same trace.

C.primary: Q-uncertainty energy: refit each fixed support with Q x 0.8 and Q x 1.25 dictionaries, VQ_g = mean ||W r_g(alt) - W r_g||^2; gain = E / (E + lambda(c) V + kappa VQ), kappa in {0.25, 0.5, 1}.
C.fallback: Gain cap: limit each group's output-to-observation energy ratio by the amplification implied by Q x 1.25; scale down groups exceeding it.
C.extra_check: Mean overall ratio over Q -30/-10 scenes and the count of scenes with error > 1 are reported for every candidate.

final_validation: After all stages, freeze code and parameters, then generate sealed models never used before: V4 new four-layer variant (new events, dip, fault, pinch-out, Q), V5 new complex geology with independent calibration; new noise seeds; Q -30..+30%. Gates versus v1: overall ratio <= 0.97, weak <= 1.02, fault <= 1.02, pinch-out <= 1.02, Q-under overall <= 1.00. Thresholds fixed now.
limits: Same simulator family; scenes share models; no significance claims.
